about: Diane St. Yves Brewer is the founder of the Law Office of Diane St. Yves, PLLC, located in Houston, Brownsville and Sugar Land, Texas. From her office in Houston, she serves clients in the surrounding areas and in Brownsville, Texas, helping them with family law matters such as divorce, child custody, estate planning, probate and guardianships.

A University of Houston graduate, Ms. Brewer received her bachelor’s in political science and government and then decided to pursue law, earning her Juris Doctor in 2006. She has also completed Russian and French language courses through the Defense Language Institute at the Presidio of Monterey.

Licensed to practice in Texas since 2007, Ms. Brewer is admitted in New Hampshire, New York and the District of Columbia. Her other bar admissions include the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit, the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern, Southern and Western Districts of Texas and the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas.
Certified as a family law specialist by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Ms. Brewer is a member of several renowned legal associations:
· The Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists
· The American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers

Ms. Brewer gives back to her community by serving as a part of the Council on Recovery’s foundation board. She has an “Excellent” rating on Avvo, and endorsements from both peers and opponents alike for her professionalism and zealous representation. Furthermore, she offers pro bono legal services through the Houston Bar Association’s Legal Line and Volunteer Lawyers.
